title: Camps C4, second half — Undo payment asks first
subtitle: Rule v1.003 (“Undo payment always asks first”) and v1.103 (the shared components/ConfirmBox.jsx). Today Camps’ Undo payment (admin: camper ⋯, or Camper detail → More on touch screens) takes the money off at once. After: it opens the shared box with loses: 'something': the question names the camper, the sentence names the payment (amount, way, date) and what is owed afterwards; the action is blue (nothing is lost for good: the history keeps both), and “Keep payment” has the first focus. While it works the action says “Undoing…” and both buttons gray; if it fails the box stays open with an amber note. After a successful Undo, today’s toast stays (“Payment undone for Chloe Martin”, no Undo). Words: Star’s, adapted (see footer). Amber = what changes.

row.caption: One click and it’s done: no question. The tag is “$315 due”; the toast has no Undo.
Tablet 820×1180 touch. Camper detail → More → Undo payment.
The detail closes; the payment is already gone.
PC, at rest. Names the payment; blue Undo payment; first focus on Keep payment (ring drawn as the keyboard sees it).
While it works: “Undoing…”, both gray; nothing moves. Esc, a click outside and Back wait.
If it fails: the box stays open, amber note under the buttons; pressing Undo payment again tries again.
Tablet touch (from Camper detail → More: the box takes the detail’s place, as Delete permanently does today).
Phone 390 touch, at rest: the same small box, side by side.
320 wide: they stack, each full width, Keep on top.

footer: Words to approve (proposal: Star’s star/candidates/text.js:164–167, approved v0.508, adapted to Camps). Title “Undo Chloe Martin’s payment?” (Star’s, unchanged). Sentence “The $315 check payment recorded on Mar 11 is reversed, so $315 is owed again. Both stay in the history.” (Star’s first and last parts; Star’s middle, “the row goes back to Not paid”, is replaced because a Camps camper can still owe part, e.g. Leo Kim “Owes $15” would owe $350 after the Undo — the amount is what is owed after). “Keep payment” (Star’s KEEP_PAYMENT). “Undo payment” with the ↶ icon (today’s menu words and icon; also the parts page’s M2 sample). “Undoing…” (the parts page’s M2 busy words for this case). Failure: “Couldn’t undo. Check the connection, then try again.” (new; Camps’ DELETE_FAILED pattern + its “Couldn’t undo.” start). Toast after: unchanged. Drawn: the After boxes are Camps’ real Delete permanently box (already the shared ConfirmBox, v0.729) with the words swapped, the action’s class turned to the blue btn-primary that ConfirmBox uses for “something”, and the busy look / amber note in ConfirmBox’s own markup; the focus ring is drawn. Script: mock-c04-undo-asks.js.
